nodes.label: ADR-004 — Result<T,E> Discriminated Union for Explicit Error Handling
nodes.rationale: Obsidian plugins share JS runtime with other plugins; uncaught exceptions can degrade the host. Explicit Result types force callers to handle errors at call site, make error surface visible in TypeScript types, avoid silent failures from swallowed try/catch blocks, and are straightforward to test.

nodes.label: Result<T,E> Discriminated Union (ok/error explicit error handling)
